_note: Art tests: animals from an outside art pack (tools/packs), tried out next to the game's own. They are not in the roster: not in the collection, cages, drafts or bots. Each exists only when a dev shortcut asks for it (the website opened with ?arttest=1, ?viewer=<id> or ?fight=<seed>&herds=..., dev tools on), as a copy of the animal it plays_as: the same stats, class, ability, attack style, footprint, width and reach, at the same level, so a test changes no gameplay. Only how it's drawn is its own: its models, portrait and sprites (art/models, art/units, made by tools/packs), and size (its longest side in tiles as drawn: set so it stands as tall on screen as the animal it plays as; with match "tallest", so its tallest pose stands as tall as that animal's tallest, for one that rests low and rears up, like the coiled Taipan) and pose_up (how much taller than standing its tallest pose is; python3 tools/packs/sizes.py measures both). pack and source say where the art comes from.
